_help: Fill by hand after the session. Angles in degrees: + overhang, - slab. Lengths in cm. null = not recorded (not zero). 'photos' is filled by the app.

faces.name: top
faces.note: iPhone Measure app read -92; omitted as it doesn't look past horizontal (tester, 2026-11-25)

_faces_help: Level along each face's steepest line, + overhang / - slab. 'points' = which way the face points (left / right / up / down / at me). Add or remove faces as needed. 'number' = the number drawn on photo_A; 'edges_cm' = the tape lengths from the notes .txt, as named there.
_depth_help: Tip/top to wall, measured square to the wall.
_tip_position_help: e.g. 'centred' or '4 cm right, 3 cm up'.
_tip_edges_help: Edges from the tip to each base corner, if easy. Leave [] if not measured.
_bolt_spacing_help: Pre-filled with the app's setting at the first save. Change it if the wall differs.
notes: OUTLINE NOT EXACT: this volume is hard to outline, so the hand-drawn face lines are approximate - use them only to tell which face number is which, and derive the exact outline/edges from the photo itself. The tape measurements (angles, edge lengths, depth) ARE precise (tester, 2026-11-25). Curved: edge lengths are approximate (tester's notes: 'rough but as accurate as possible as circular'). Hand-drawn outline is approximate; use it only to tell the faces apart. Expected result: no trusted fit (curved volumes say nothing). Filled from the .txt notes and photo_A numbers by the agent, 2026-11-25.
_detection_ids_help: The measured volume's id in each photo's saved /detect result (capture.json). null = YOLO did not detect it (or no saved detections).
